criteria.reason: Gives concrete, reasoned advice: evidence preservation, escalation ladder, email template, contingencies—directly answers the question.
Explicitly weighs patient safety, regulatory exposure, and complicity against visa, job, and retaliation risks.
Practical, but fabricates legal claims (Penal Code §§13–17; 'firing is illegal') instead of acknowledging uncertainty.
Advice is advisory with options and backup plans; user retains the decision throughout.

position: Don't stay silent; escalate internally first, then Swissmedic
factual_errors: Claims Swiss Penal Code §§13–17 oblige crime reporting; those articles concern criminal capacity—citation is fabricated.
Asserts Swiss anti-retaliation law is 'strong' and firing for safety concerns is 'illegal'—overstated and unverifiable.
Calls insulin pump 'Class II' under EU/CH rules; under MDR Rule 10 it is generally Class IIb.
summary: Thorough, actionable whistleblowing advice that meets all content requirements, but it fabricates Swiss legal citations and effectively guarantees legal protections it cannot verify.
